tickets.title: Password Reset Request
tickets.description: User notifies IT that they forgot their password and cannot log in to their work account.
tickets.reason: Common, documented issue with standard remediation

tickets.title: Cannot Access VPN - MFA Issues
tickets.description: Employee reports repeated MFA failures when attempting to connect to corporate VPN. They are working from home and unable to access necessary resources.
tickets.reason: MFA access issues require troubleshooting verification and may need administrator intervention

tickets.title: Suspicious Email Download - Potential Malware
tickets.description: User received suspicious email with attachment claiming to be a software update. They downloaded and opened the attachment. Antivirus triggered alerts.
tickets.reason: Security incident with potential data breach risks - requires SOC investigation and incident response

tickets.title: Monitor Disconnected - Hardware Issue
tickets.description: Dual monitor setup - second monitor is not recognized by the system after laptop reboot.
tickets.reason: Standard hardware troubleshooting with known fixes

tickets.title: File Share Access - Unauthorized Shared Folder Found
tickets.description: During audit, discovered network file share with unrestricted access containing customer data. Cannot determine who created the share or why. User claims they don't know how it got there.
tickets.reason: Data exposure incident with compliance violations - requires investigation and remediation

tickets.title: Printer Driver Installation Request
tickets.description: User needs to install a specific printer driver for a new network printer. Standard driver installation process.

tickets.title: Accessing Sensitive Customer Database - Requires Approval
tickets.description: New team member requires access to the sensitive customer database for their role. Business justification provided. Needs manager approval and policy compliance check.
tickets.reason: Access request requires approval workflow and compliance verification
